summary: The 2026 LLM landscape is dominated by a handful of frontier families—OpenAI's GPT, Anthropic's Claude, and Google's Gemini—whose real-world adoption is amplified by broad availability across enterprise aggregators like AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex. Open-weight models from DeepSeek, Meta, Mistral, Alibaba (Qwen), and Zhipu (GLM) have surged in developer usage thanks to strong HuggingFace download numbers and cost efficiency. Rankings below reflect a blend of API call volume, developer surveys, HuggingFace stats, and enterprise aggregator reach, limited strictly to models confirmed publicly available today.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Consistently the most-called model across OpenAI's direct API and Azure OpenAI, with the broadest enterprise aggregator reach of any model and top mindshare in developer surveys.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications requiring multimodal capabilities and broad platform support

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Default frontier model on Google Vertex AI with deep integration across Google Cloud enterprise customers and a leading 1M+ token context window driving heavy adoption.
models.best_for: Long-context document analysis and enterprise workloads on Google Cloud

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: The workhorse Claude model for coding and agentic tasks, available via Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex, giving it enormous enterprise reach.
models.best_for: Software development, coding assistants, and agentic enterprise workflows

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: Leading open-weight model with massive HuggingFace download volume and widespread hosting across inference providers due to its strong performance-to-cost ratio.
models.best_for: Cost-sensitive production deployments and self-hosted open-weight applications

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.popularity_notes: Anthropic's top-tier frontier model for complex reasoning, heavily used in high-value enterprise workflows and available across AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI.
models.best_for: Complex reasoning, research, and high-stakes coding tasks

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: High-volume, low-latency model widely adopted for cost-efficient production workloads through Vertex AI and the Gemini API.

models.name: o3
models.popularity_notes: OpenAI's flagship reasoning model, widely used for complex problem-solving and available through both the OpenAI API and Azure OpenAI.
models.best_for: Complex reasoning, STEM, and analytical problem-solving tasks

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and broadly available via AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI for self-hosted and managed deployments.
models.best_for: Self-hosted and customizable open-weight enterprise deployments

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: Popular open-weight reasoning model with high HuggingFace download numbers, offering frontier-level reasoning at a fraction of proprietary costs.
models.best_for: Cost-efficient reasoning and analytical tasks with open-weight flexibility

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: Alibaba's flagship open-weight MoE model with rapidly growing HuggingFace adoption and strong multilingual and coding performance.

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Europe's leading frontier model, available via AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI, with strong adoption among EU enterprises prioritizing data sovereignty.
models.best_for: European enterprise deployments and multilingual applications

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Anthropic's fast, low-cost model adopted for high-volume lightweight tasks and available across AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, and the Anthropic API.
models.best_for: High-volume, latency-sensitive tasks requiring low cost
